summary: Iteration-2 focused testing of newly added features: product cost/HPP, purchases (stock-in), stock opname, cash in/out, gross-profit & cash fields in report summary, WIB bucketing, and frontend Products/Inventory/Cash/Dashboard + offline mode. Backend: 32 pytest cases (31 pass, 1 fail exposing a real bug). Frontend: all new flows verified end-to-end via Playwright with admin + kasir accounts, including offline sale + auto-sync. Test data cleaned up afterwards.

critical.issue: ProductIn.stock defaults to 0 and update does a full $set, so any update payload omitting `stock` silently ZEROES a retail product's stock (verified: stock 25 -> 0). Same risk for `cost` (defaults 0). Should either require stock for retail or only $set provided fields.

minor.issue: No single-product GET endpoint (returns 405 Method Not Allowed); clients must fetch the whole list to verify a product.

No brute-force lockout / rate limiting on failed logins (bcrypt $2b$12 hashing and idempotent seed_admin with password-change update are correct; JWT Bearer + localStorage is by design, so no httpOnly cookie / allow_credentials needed).

ui_bugs.issue: Dialog panel renders translucent while opening — table rows behind are readable through the modal body; also React warning: missing Description/aria-describedby for DialogContent.

React console error 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option> — this will cause a hydration error' on Inventory.jsx:66 product <option> (label expression wrapped in span). Functionally works but pollutes console/hydration.

rca_of_the_issue: PUT /api/products/{id} builds the update doc from ProductIn.model_dump(); ProductIn declares stock: Optional[int] = 0 and cost: float = 0, so any payload lacking those keys writes 0 via $set, destroying inventory. Repro: create retail product with stock=25, PUT name/sku/type/price/cost only -> stock becomes 0. The React Products form currently always sends stock, so the UI masks it, but API/import/partial clients will lose stock. Mitigation: model_dump(exclude_unset=True) or a dedicated ProductUpdate model.
